title: DARC-CLIP: DYNAMIC ADAPTIVE REFINEMENT WITH CROSS-ATTENTION FOR MEME UNDERSTANDING
reasoning: The paper focuses on multimodal meme understanding for tasks such as hate speech detection, target classification, and stance detection within the context of the LGBTQ+ movement. While it deals with socially sensitive content and harmful speech detection, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or formal moral and ethical systems.
